$comment: Semantic classification rules. EDIT THIS FILE, not the Python, to change how source tags map to map classes. Re-run `py pipeline/classify.py` afterwards. The style layer keys on the `class` values produced here, never on raw OSM tags.

paths.$comment: OSM highway value -> semantic class. Anything not listed is ignored (street_lamp, bus_stop, crossing, turning_circle, traffic_signals, stop are nodes/furniture, not routes).
paths.$comment_width: Base render width in pixels at zoom 17, stamped onto each feature as `base_width`. Lives here beside the class definition so width and class are edited together; the style just reads ['get','base_width'] and interpolates by zoom.
paths.$comment_step_free: Classes that are never step-free. Used to build the accessible routing profile. The prototype left `steps` routable in its accessible profile - that bug must not return.
paths.$comment_routable: Classes that may appear in a walking route at all.
paths.$comment_profiles: Named routing profiles. Each lists the classes it will traverse.
paths.$comment_access: Tag values that exclude a way from routing entirely.
paths.$comment_surface: Surface values are passed through unchanged. Listed here so the style has a known vocabulary to work against.
paths.$comment_step_free_surface: Surfaces flagged as potentially unsuitable for wheeled access. Advisory only - requires estate validation, never asserted as fact.

parking.$comment: Parking is its own layer so it stops rendering as road-coloured asphalt, which is the prototype's most visible styling error.

buildings.$comment: Any feature carrying a `building` tag. 1,171 of 1,412 in the source are the untyped `building=yes`, so `class` is mostly a fallback. NO source building carries height, building:levels, roof:shape or roof:material - heights come from pipeline/heights.py (Phase 2).

landcover.$comment: Polygons with landuse/leisure/natural and no building tag.

barriers.$comment: Linear barriers. The prototype drew these by default while the legend described a different layer entirely.

provenance.$comment: Stamped onto every output feature. Keeps the prototype's best habit: nothing claims to be surveyed unless it is.
